description: CLI for the Caesar search API: web search with provenance for agents and scripts
rules: Always pass --json for machine output; parse stdout as JSON and stderr error envelopes
Branch on exit codes: 0 ok, 2 bad input, 3 auth, 4 API error, 5 timeout
The flag is --max-results (not --results or --limit); modes are standard|research
Continue truncated reads with --start-char instead of increasing --max-chars
Set CAESAR_API_KEY; never paste literal keys into configs or shell history
